items.title: 56712_Cootie Williams oral history interview
items.q: Bobby Stark says, 'Hey, you big so and so, leave that boy alone... I was more impressed with Bobby Stark than I was with Hawk.'

ctx.x: Yeah. And so we kept on playing and kept on playing. So Bobby Stark says, "Hey, you big so and so, leave that boy alone. Don't you bother that boy. Shut up and leave that boy alone." And he shut up.
